No DATE NOTE  BVLNC, J 01. 15.07.2024 I.A.No.1 OF 2024 Heard.
Dispensed with for the time being.
_ BVLNC, J Crl.P.No.4787 OF 2024 Heard learned counsel representing for the petitioners and learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1/State.

Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that the petitioners herein are the accused Nos.9 to 12 in C.C.No.2901 of 2022, on the file of the II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class,
Nellore, for the offences under Sections 420, 406, 506 r/w 34 IPC.

entities.text:
II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class,
Nellore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He would further submit that the petitioners are residing separately from A-5 and the 2nd respondent.

The 2nd respondent not satisfied with the earlier complaint, filed the present complaint after two years against the other family members of A-5 with a motive to exercise pressure on the family members by hook or crook resorted to the present crime.
Hence, the proceedings against the petitioners are abuse of process of law.

Contd., ::2::
Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners, "the presence of A9 to A12 in proceedings in C.C.No.2901 of 2022, on the file of the II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nellore, is dispensed with, except on the dates directed by the learned Magistrate".

entities.text: II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nellore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Issue notice to the respondent No.2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice to the respondent No.2 through registered post with acknowledgment due and file proof of service into the Registry within a period of six (06) weeks.
List the matter after six (06) weeks.
